packs.title: At school
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: Pencils, erasers, a schoolbag, a writing brush and a blackboard for your world, plus classmates, homework, exams and 上课 / 下课, a day-at-school story, and 14 sentences to read.

packs.title: Festivals
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: Chinese New Year, Mid-Autumn and Dragon Boat Festival: red envelopes, firecrackers, couplets, zongzi and a dragon boat for your world, New Year greetings, the old legend of the Nian monster as a short book, and 14 sentences to read.

packs.title: First stories
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: Two very short stories to read in characters: a kitten looking for friends, and a snowy day. Tap any word to hear it and see what it means.

packs.title: In the kitchen
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: Bowls, chopsticks, noodles and a big fridge for your world, plus 好吃 (tasty) and 做饭 (to cook), and 14 sentences to read.

packs.title: Journey to the West
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: The Monkey King and friends from the classic novel: his golden staff, his somersault cloud, peaches of immortality and a demon's gourd for your world, the heroes' names, the birth of the stone monkey as a short book, and 14 sentences to read.

packs.title: The Apothecary Diaries
packs.author: Shénbǐ (unofficial fan pack)
packs.description: Herbs, poisons and palace life, themed on The Apothecary Diaries (药屋少女的呢喃): 20 words (a medicine chest, silver needles, a hairpin…, plus 猫猫 Maomao and 壬氏 Jinshi), a short story of our own about a poisoned cat, and 15 sentences to read.

packs.title: Two more poems
packs.author: Shénbǐ
packs.description: 悯农 (why you shouldn't waste rice) and 相思 (red beans for a friend you miss). Like the game's own poems, they fill in by themselves as you learn their words.
